Name: Loot Filter Item Pickup Filter (No Longer Maintained)
Author: Darkmushu1
Description:
I'm quitting modding to explore other things in life, whoever wants to take over the project and or maintain just let me know and I can add a redirect link here to your Nexus mod page.

[b]What does this mod do:[/b]
[list]
[*]Apply your loot filter list so filtered items aren't automatically picked up into your inventory, instead will be placed back into the world with a bit distance from your character to prevent it being dragged back into your inventory.[/*]
[*]Filter loot item by going into menu, hold item then press X to add to filter list, you can repeat step to remove item from filter.[/*]
[*]You can also instead use generic mod config menu to go into and filter a category of item instead of individual item. Like filter all shirts. Category filter overrides individual filter item list.[/*]
[*]Press Z to turn off filter to pick up item.
[/*]
[*]Filter doesn't apply when any menu is open so that you can transfer items from chest to inventory with item being filter.[/*]
[/list]
Some other information:[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1n4iHBCehto1_2i9uY-Oxxj5GnZeBz-1s/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=100090291448919161336&rtpof=true&sd=true]
V1.0.1 Updates:
[youtube]zke8RA0uXj8[/youtube]

[/url][b]Platform:[/b]
Works on PC, Haven't tested on Steam Deck (Linux) but should work, some reported works ok on Mac, May crash game on Mobile when user tries to use "Add Item To Loot Filter" because mobile doesn't have item held function but should be able to use the category filter.

[b]Requires:[/b]
SMAPI
